Body.Content:
Azure Resource Graph, now in preview, enables fast exploration of your resources for efficient inventory management.

Use Azure Resource Graph to:

  • Explore all your resources through the Azure Portal, PowerShell, or CLI.
  • Perform powerful queries.
  • Parse through all resource properties.

Learn more.
